messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in Stripe webhook/API 429s and signature verification errors observed. Affected endpoints: POST /webhooks/stripe, GET /api/billing/invoice/* — failure rate ~18% for webhooks, 12% for API calls. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/stripe/stripe-webhooks (alerts: stripe.webhook.429, stripe.api.429). Thread started 1771236543.

Priya L.: I'm oncall, pinging Matt and Ethan. Paging PD. @pagerduty-bot please escalate to SRE P1. :telephone_receiver:

pagerduty-bot: Incident triggered and paged oncall: Matt S. — priority P1.

Matt S.: saw it. I'm looking at the webhook consumer logs now. Receiving a mix of 429s from stripe and a bunch of signature verification failures (HMAC mismatch). Quick dump of recent log snippets:```
2026-05-08T09:02:12Z INFO webhook_handler received event evt_1abc... status=200
2026-05-08T09:02:35Z WARN webhook_delivery stripe_resp=429 retry_after=60 path=/v1/events
2026-05-08T09:02:35Z ERROR sig_verification failed event_id=evt_1def... header_sig=t=...v1=... computed_sig=...
```

Ethan K.: Stripe status page shows an ongoing degradation in webhook delivery and API rate limiting in us-west-2: https://status.stripe.com/ — customer-facing billing APIs degraded. Ticket from stripe-notify-bot: TICKET#87421 (Stripe ongoing delivery throttling).

Megan R.: Customer impact: customers with queued invoices are hitting errors when we call GET /v1/invoices/{id} to show invoices -> UI shows "billing unavailable", some downstream provisioning checks that call Stripe API are failing causing temporary access blocks for trial customers. We have a backlog of ~1.8k invoice read failures in the last 15m.

Priya L.: Action plan (short): 1) Stop strict failure path that marks accounts as delinquent on transient GET failures. Switch to cached invoice fallback (circuit-breaker -> serve cached invoice for 15m). 2) Increase webhook consumer concurrency and enable longer retry windows. 3) Contact Stripe support + share ticket. 4) Replay webhooks once delivery stabilizes.

Matt S.: Implementing (1) now. Patch: small change to billing-check flow to treat 429 as transient and use cached response if available. Config snippet I'm rolling:```yaml
billing: 
  invoice_cache_ttl_seconds: 900
  treat_http_429_as_transient: true
```
Rolling to staging then prod (canary 10%).

Priya L.: Make sure to add logging for customers that we display cached invoices for (so support can triage). Also add a temporary banner in status page: "Intermittent billing lookup errors impacting invoice display; retries in progress." @Megan R. can you draft? :memo:

Megan R.: Drafted banner and incident notice. Posting in status and to support playbook now. Also para-sent support email to top 20 customers likely impacted.

stripe-notify-bot: Stripe is reporting delivery throttling in some regions, quote: "We are currently addressing a surge causing webhook retries and API 429 responses. We have mitigation in progress." Ref: https://status.stripe.com/incident/2026-05-08.

Ethan K.: Observed pattern: our webhook consumer's average latency spiked ~3-4x around 08:55 UTC which correlates with upstream 429s. Hypothesis: Stripe's retry backoff + our slow processing caused delivery bursts -> upstream throttling -> signature mismatches for replays (older signatures?) Not certain.

Matt S.: Canary patch deployed to 10% — metrics: webhook 429 rate on canary hosts dropped from 18% -> 9% (small sample) after increasing worker concurrency and extending retry window. I'm going to promote to 50% then 100% if looks stable.

Priya L.: I'll perform on-call handoff notes for next shift (Ethan takes follow). Handing to Ethan in 20m. Current status: mitigations in progress, Stripe engaged, customers notified, temporary cached invoice fallback active. Severity: P1 (customer impact: invoice display + trial gating).

Ethan K.: Taking handoff. Next steps I'm going to: 1) Monitor Stripe ticket + logs, 2) coordinate replay job once Stripe confirms delivery stable, 3) prepare postmortem checklist and RCA outline. If we need to, consider request to Stripe for redelivery of failed webhook events (using their dashboard /support API).

Matt S.: FYI for the replay plan: we should only replay after Stripe confirms they have stopped throttling and after we ensure signature verification logic expects potential replays (avoid duplicate processing). Also add dedupe by event id. Quick dedupe pseudocode:```
if event_id in processed_store: ack else process -> mark processed
```

Priya L.: Contact with Stripe support: we have opened TICKET#87421, we asked for (a) confirmation of regional throttle window, (b) whether there was a signing key rotation (to explain HMAC mismatches), (c) redelivery options. Stripe replied: "We saw delivery throttling due to increased retries; no signing key rotation detected. Redelivery will be queued once delivery stabilizes."

Megan R.: Support notes: customers LB-42 and ACME reported access interruption. I've opened CS tickets and proactively applied manual grace for trial gating for impacted customers while billing checks are flaky.

Priya L.: Timeline/notes for post-incident: - 08:50 UTC: spike starts - 09:02 UTC: alerts fired - 09:08 UTC: PD page -> oncall engaged - 09:12 UTC: cached-invoice fallback enabled - 09:20 UTC: canary increased to 10% - 09:40 UTC: canary -> 50% - 10:00 UTC: Stripe confirms throttling easing (tentative) - 10:10 UTC: start replay planning

Ethan K.: Logging/metrics action items: add metric for "served_from_invoice_cache" and alert if >1% for >5m; add webhook delivery dedupe counter; increase retention for webhook raw payloads to 72h for debugging.

Matt S.: Ops action items: add automation to lower concurrency (or pause replay) if upstream 429s rise above X, implement stronger backoff on our retries so we don't cause amplification during upstream issues.

Priya L.: Communication: will send a short incident update to internal general channel and update the status page. We'll keep this thread for technical coordination. :thumbsup:

Megan R.: Internal update posted. Support is tracking customer list and manual grace is applied to impacted accounts.

stripe-notify-bot: Status update from Stripe: "Mitigation progressing; redelivery queue building." ETA unknown.

Matt S.: Promoted canary to 100% now. Watching metrics. If 429s spike again I'll rollback.

Ethan K.: I'll take 1-hr watch. If no regression in that window, we can start controlled replay of webhooks (rate-limited). We should notify support channel prior to replay to avoid double-billing confusion.

Priya L.: Handing off: primary oncall -> Ethan K., secondary -> Matt S. Handoff note: mitigations active, Stripe engaged, customer grace for billing checks applied, replay pending confirmation. Logging and postmortem owners assigned.

Matt S.: Quick follow-up: added temporary metric to Grafana: stripe.billing.cached_fallback_count and wired alert to SRE oncall at 1% threshold.

Ethan K.: Thanks all. I'll post a follow-up in ~45m with status and next steps. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
